item.tib: ma mo gze gyad spar ma'i thun sgrub
item.coloph: ma mo gze gyad spar ma'i thun sgrub/ mkha' lding sgyar lding bsgyur/ sha ba rgyug 'gyel li shu stag ring yang snying / (?)bsam yas kyi gter ma/ dbu mchod kyi dngos grub/ dir ston la brgyud pa/ dbu sgom ston gyis zhus pa'o/ 'di la gang zhig gang mtshon pa/ sbod stong ngan pa kun bzlog nas/ bkra shis longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ e ma ho//
